principles: Motion supports orientation, hierarchy, and state change.

Primary surface-swap language is opacity + blur + scale; persistent top-card route swaps use a continuous snapshot wheel/tape with opacity + vertical translation + scale and no blur.

motion: PersistentSiteFrame maps / to the to-profile top card and keeps AnimatedTopCard mounted across route changes.
Home heading and case list use sequenced page reveal.

Case-item glass and preview are gated by per-target reveal readiness: both actual CSS animations of that target must settle, including its own stagger. Hover or focus held on the item opens automatically when it becomes ready; instant and reduced-motion targets are ready immediately. This does not wait for the global reveal sequence or block link navigation.

Active case glass position uses velocity-preserving physics with mass 0.9: smoothstep remains for stiffness 320..460, while a reference damping curve of approximately 0.80..0.62 uses a normalized exponential ease-out measured in actual item steps with scale 4.5. The start-from-rest theoretical peak stays physical and unchanged through 12px, then an exponential target-amplitude curve toward an 18px asymptote is converted into effective damping (approximately 0.7566 at maximum travel). Approach crossing time is normalized to 1.20x the reference spring with damping-aware flight compensation; the post-target distance-aware tail time-warp remains 1x..2x. Initial inherited velocity is pre-compensated for the active flight scale in copied spring options; size morph uses 220/22/1.0.

Pointer shift targets ±16px/±10px through a 300/24/0.75 spring with power 1.4; active text follows 25% over 420ms expressive easing, and an optional item-local sticker follows 50% of the same raw target through its own 300/24/0.75 spring, bounded to ±8px/±5px. Sticker activation waits the shared 280ms glass-opacity duration, then fades and deblurs over motion-page-reveal 700ms with expressive easing; deactivation fades out and blurs immediately over 280ms. Outgoing text returns explicitly over 600ms standard easing, re-entry hands the current transform back to CSS without a jump, the glass uses 1400px perspective, and the shared close delay remains 380ms.
Hover preview is a fine-pointer desktop enhancement and swaps media with blur/opacity/scale transitions; reduced motion uses opacity only.

motion: Case items reveal with the shared page-reveal language.

Each case item's glass and preview wait for that item's own reveal animations to settle, then auto-open for a stationary pointer or retained focus; instant and reduced-motion items are ready immediately.
Active case text follows 25% of pointer shift over 420ms expressive easing; outgoing text returns through WAAPI over 600ms standard easing, and re-entry preserves its current visual transform.

Glass position preserves spring velocity: smoothstep maps distance to stiffness 320..460, and a separate 4.5-step exponential reference damping curve runs from approximately 0.80 to 0.62. Its theoretical start-from-rest overshoot is unchanged through 12px, then an exponential amplitude target toward 18px is converted into effective spring damping, reaching approximately 0.7566 at maximum travel. There is no visual post-crossing compression: the spring peaks and reverses physically. Damping-aware flight scaling normalizes approach crossing to 1.20x the reference spring, then the existing distance-aware 1x..2x tail scale takes over; copied spring options pre-compensate inherited velocity for the active flight scale; size uses a 220/22/1.0 lightweight morph spring.
Glass follows pointer targets ±16px/±10px with restrained transform depth and 1400px perspective.

A case item renders one sticker layer only when its slug has a non-empty itemStickers frame array in home.mdx. The non-interactive sticker is positioned inside that item's own itemVisualBounds above the glass, so the old sticker fades in place instead of following the glass geometry to another item.

The sticker uses --home-arrow-size (27px), reserves no bubble width, anchors at right: -50% of its size and top: -1/2 of --home-item-gap, keeps a permanent -15deg counterclockwise orientation, and follows 50% of the raw pointer target with its own spring without inheriting the glass transform. Horizontal glass intersection is 13.5px at rest and 5.5px..21.5px at sticker parallax extremes. Text follows 25% of raw shift, so its maximum relative inward delta is 4px and the existing 18px padding retains an approximately 0.5px minimum gap; only 4px of the sticker extends above the top edge at rest.

Glass opacity remains motion-base 280ms. Sticker activation reuses that duration as a 280ms delay, then enters over motion-page-reveal 700ms through opacity 0→1 and blur 4px→0px with expressive easing. Deactivation starts immediately and exits over 280ms through opacity 1→0 and blur 0px→4px, cancelling delayed entry cleanly during rapid switches.

All configured SVG frames are eagerly preloaded as stacked images and switch discretely through visibility with no inner motion, opacity, blur, scale, crossfade, or frame transition. A single-frame array stays static and the outer 700ms opacity/deblur appearance remains unchanged.

A single-frame array stays static and does not start the cycle. When multiple frames are configured, the visible frame changes every semantic motion-sticker-cycle interval of 200ms (5fps) after the initial 280ms sticker delay.

Only the active item's recursive timeout chain runs. Activation resets the visible source to frame 0; deactivation cancels all timeouts. Reduced motion shows frame 0 only and does not start the cycle. Portfoliocase currently uses only Puffy Sparkle Darker Violet, while Globus uses the single static Clock Neutral sticker; Codex, GitHub, Metrica, and Puffy Star Darker Yellow remain commented in home.mdx.

Every frame keeps the shared 27px by 27px DOM/image container. Puffy Sparkle Darker Violet and Clock Neutral normalize their source artwork through viewBox 2.75 2.75 18.5 18.5, filling approximately 26.3–26.9px of the container without CSS scaling. The scale(1.1) mapping for the currently commented Puffy Star Darker Yellow remains available; tool images and the outer motion/rotation/parallax wrapper are not scaled.
Reduced motion preserves sticker opacity sequencing while forcing blur and glass, text, and sticker parallax transforms to zero; mobile hides the sticker with the glass.

motion: MDX headings, paragraphs, list items, blockquotes, sections, and media wrappers reveal sequentially.

Lightbox arrows, thumbnails and context card wait 120ms after opening geometry completes, then fade from opacity 0 to 1 over 400ms. Pointer/focus cannot bypass this once-per-session gate; reduced motion skips the fade and media navigation does not restart the delay.

After the opening gate, desktop arrow and thumbnail hit areas remain active when their visuals fade. A stationary pointer keeps the close indicator suppressed; clicking an invisible arrow navigates and clicking an invisible thumbnail selects its media. Suppression clears only on actual pointer exit or lightbox close.
The lower white lightbox gradient declaration is retained as a CSS comment and does not render. Progressive blur extends 60px above the base lower-control region.

Static 0/8/16px ProgressiveBlur filter layers retain the existing mask positions and fade with the controls over 400ms through animated mask alpha, without animating filter opacity or wrapper opacity; reduced motion makes the fade immediate.

GalleryLightboxScope combines openable image and video items across full-case Gallery blocks. GalleryLightbox keeps a persistent shell and decoded low-resolution DOM image layers; only current/adjacent full-resolution layers are retained. Selection, context and final geometry change immediately, with no crossfade or re-open animation; context glass, title and body transitions are disabled during media navigation, and remounted context wrappers do not replay initial opacity fade. A cold target leaves an empty image area, without loading labels, placeholders or error messages. Rail centering and active crop expansion share a fixed 200ms duration. On desktop, clicks in the free horizontal track outside the occupied thumbnail region close the lightbox; the occupied thumbnails and their internal gaps remain interactive. The top-layer floating close indicator hides over a semantic flex wrapper containing only real thumbnails and their internal gaps, while outer centering spacers stay outside the hover zone; both full-height navigation zones and the context card suppress it through a Set of active region IDs without pointermove geometry reads. Only the collapsed 92%-white context card with a 12px backdrop blur is hug-sized, with a regular black title, 8px/20.8px token padding and pill radius. Actionable cards spring-expand to 560px on hover/focus with a local 420/36/1.6 spring for width, vertical padding and details height, retaining --space-xl horizontal padding and changing the radius linearly over 400ms from half the measured compact height to the bubble radius in both directions, crossfade the title to heavy over 60ms and reveal body copy (up to three lines) from below the clipped card edge: body text moves only vertically from 80px below its expanded position after 120ms with the title vertical-axis 420/36/1.6 spring and opacity fades from 0 to 1 over 200ms after 160ms; reverse has no delay. A fixed centering wrapper keeps the card centered and its bottom edge fixed. The glass surface is the clipped semantic link; invisible geometry drives its height, while an independently centered fixed-width content layer avoids text scaling, reflow and expanded-title ellipsis during the width spring. Compact width hugs the complete regular title until the viewport cap, and both title weights are anchored to the fixed-width inner content layer and travel independently of glass resize from compact center to expanded upper-left while crossfading; both title positions follow the same oval arc: both directions use the glass spring stiffness and damping with 90% of its mass (default 420/36/1.44), retaining spring overshoot at both endpoints. The compact hover zone is 20px wider than the compact card in total (10px each side); the expanded card holds hover inside that zone until pointer exit, without a re-entry lock. Optional ?lightboxDebug=1 exposes a nonpersistent panel for shared resize/title/text spring stiffness, damping and mass, text travel distance, text-rise delay, opacity delay/duration, title crossfade duration, radius duration and Reset, only while an actionable context card is open. Defaults: glass/body spring 420/36/1.6 and title spring 420/36/1.44, text travel 80px, rise delay 120ms, fade delay 160ms, fade duration 200ms, title crossfade 60ms, radius duration 400ms. On touch, the first card tap expands, the second opens the case; the first outside tap collapses only the card and the next outside tap closes the lightbox. Full cases use the nearest preceding heading (or the case title before the first heading) and the first nonempty paragraph of that section for every media, regardless of caption. Media in the same Gallery share the same title and paragraph. The full card remains one semantic link to the source in the case, without a visible action label. Short cases show only the caption heading in a compact non-expanding card and hide it without a caption. About has no context card. Keyboard-open sessions restore focus on ordinary close, but ArrowLeft navigation to the previous item and ArrowRight navigation to the next item suppress restoration to the source media because the active item changed; keyboard navigation does not reveal hidden controls, and subsequent Tab navigation may enable accessible restoration again. Non-cyclic navigation, responsive controls, source-aware close motion and reduced-motion fallback remain; the short-case render gets an isolated scope.

The portfoliocase MDX can render a non-interactive three-scene PortfolioMotionDemo in a fixed-height white borderless viewport: top card, short mode, and one Portfolio as a Product case. The motion rhythm is slowed by 1.2x: outgoing travels from 0 to 120px over 720ms with cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.84, 0), while incoming reaches the apex at the 1440ms lifecycle boundary with mirrored cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Outgoing opacity stays at 1 and blur at 0px through the first 60px, then changes to 0 and 18px. Incoming starts when outgoing opacity reaches 0.5 at about 683ms and is fully opaque and deblurred after its first 60px at about 760ms. Equal scene visibility peaks at about 24.4/24.4 percent, below the 30/30 limit. Every scene crosses 0deg into the opposite rotation, following either -15deg -> 0deg -> 15deg or 15deg -> 0deg -> -15deg, with starting directions alternating continuously across the loop. The opacity >= 0.8 guard starts the production animations: the top-card to-profile -> to-home switch and the short-mode switch each wait 280ms before starting, all top-card states continuously run the production 620ms icon hover cycle, and short mode remains 2x. Top card keeps --home-top-card-width on every viewport; the single case keeps the production bubble's natural text-sized proportions, is uniformly scaled to 1.2x, and is centered in the scene, proportionally enlarging its text, sticker, radius, shadows, and bubble deformation. The case combines entry and exit into one continuous trajectory without pausing at the apex, and changes opacity and blur only after its first 60px on either leg. Its glass bubble waits 140ms after the case appears, fades over 280ms, and scales from 0.1 to 1 with a spring tail using 220 / 14 / 1 before the sticker frame cycle begins. The viewport is 412px high and shifts the scene center upward by 68.8px, placing the trajectory apex at about 137.2px versus the upper-third target of about 137.3px. The remaining lower area contains the full fall, rotation, blur tail, and case scale without clipping. Every exiting scene calls safeToRemove after 720ms, so a cyclic key cannot reuse an instance with already-mutated motion values. A visibility-aware timeout pauses while the document is hidden and resets one presence session on return, preventing accumulated exit layers. The explicit loop handoff and reduced-motion fallback remain non-interactive.
